control.requiredAdapter: A build for this exact Minecraft version and loader with the seven minecraft_client_* tool contracts; NeoForge JAR cannot be used as a substitute
control.operatingSystem: Windows prepared isolated desktop; rendered graphics context required
portingNotes: Rebind loader event registration and input hooks to this target

gameOptions.backgroundFps: Explicitly configure and record a limit matching the foreground comparison
gameOptions.shaders: Exact shader pack and settings, or disabled

requiredInputs: Prepared launch root with final-preflight.json, launch.ps1 and launch/java-arguments.txt
Quick-play test save or verified version-specific enter-world sequence

phases.fixture: Fresh disposable world plus empty VSS prediction namespace; preserve a pristine copy
observe: time from accepted profile and first interval separately
phases.pass: Fixed nonzero target set, fresh measured intervals, within explicit case limits; screenshots reviewed

phases.fixture: One-shot prepared root cloned after cold client closes; same world/mods/options; copy prediction and Voxy caches after all writers stop
phases.pass: Warm-cache hits observed and same fixed target reaches required coverage; compare durations with same origin

phases.fixture: Same seed/preset and target mods; production key and look actions on a fixed route
phases.pass: Route actually traversed, progress resumes after movement, no failed rendering, visual review

phases.fixture: Explicit internal off -> loading options using the same config fields as the UI
phases.pass: State transitions observed and both screenshots reviewed; performance quality is never changed automatically

phases.fixture: Leave and reenter the same save in the same Java process through the target-specific GUI sequence
phases.pass: Second entry renders prediction and reaches the case demand threshold

phases.fixture: Loaded reference points at peaks, valleys, rivers/coasts, biome borders and mod-specific terrain; avoid edited or structure-modified ground
observe: same X/Z preview and exact heights
phases.pass: Enough noncaptured same-coordinate evidence within explicit per-LOD tolerances, no missing points, image review

evidence.frameReview: Required verdict with concrete observations bound to PNG SHA-256
evidence.performance: Frame capture and terrain probes run outside measured intervals
forbiddenClaims: Compile success is not game acceptance
Task failure count zero is not correct terrain
Raw generator columns are not final post-decoration blocks
A readback of real captured terrain is not independent prediction proof
